subject: Welcome to One Voice (and one rehearsal fix)
previewText: Every Wednesday: one thing to try at your next rehearsal. Here is the first one.
opening:
Hi everyone!

You signed up for my newsletter at dekesharon.com, and some of you did that months ago. Thank you for waiting.

Starting now, One Voice arrives every Wednesday morning. It is short: one thing you can try at your next rehearsal, the best video of the week, and what is happening in Total Vocal, my a cappella community. Here is the first one.
tryThis:
Do you have too much free time? Of course not. So start rehearsal on time.

If rehearsal starts at 7 p.m., start at 7 p.m. and zero seconds. People start showing up on time, and anyone who walks in a little late jumps right in.

inside.text: That tip is one of four I recorded for directors and singers. All four are in one short video, free inside Total Vocal.

question: Does your group start on time? Hit reply and tell me.
